requirements.content_instructions: Uploaded candidate photograph; file size: 100-5 mixed: KB minimum; MB maximum; background: light or white.
rejection_conditions: Shadows on the face or background are not accepted.
Non-frontal or side-facing pose can fail the stated requirement.
Eyes must be visible/open as stated.
Spectacle glare, dark or coloured glasses can make the photograph unacceptable.
Caps/hats are restricted; any permitted religious covering must leave required facial features visible.

requirements[1].file_spec.file_size.maxi.reasoning: No published signature file size for this body. Standing in with the modal published specification across the researched set (10-20 KB), which falls inside five of the six distinct published ranges. The arithmetic mean (10.6-45.2 KB) was rejected: its ceiling exceeds five of those six, and overshooting a maximum is a hard portal rejection.

application_rejection_conditions: Incomplete application forms will be summarily rejected.
Application form sent by Post/Courier will not be entertained and hence be rejected.
Any inconsistency or mismatch in Aadhaar or APAAR details may lead to delays or rejection of the application.

Failure of the candidate in entering full and correct information in the online application form and/or suppression of any information would lead to disqualification of the candidate for MHT-CET-2026 or even at later date.
